method: Deterministic split, seed 42. Quota per restaurant allocated proportionally by largest remainder (25 hold-out of 100 reviews, 4 restaurants x 25). Within each restaurant, reviews were picked greedily to minimise the absolute deviation between the hold-out label distribution (5 aspects x 4 classes) and the restaurant's own label distribution; ties broken by a seed-42 shuffle.
